notes.subject: פתים
notes.rationale: Awal-agi am tzermiyin (tiqectban) yettban-d kan dig wemkan-agi; kra n tsuqilin qqurent-t d 'aban' (BSB)

notes.subject: קרחו/קרתו
notes.rationale: Allitération n yiẓar-agi iy ddan (qeRaḥ / qaRaH), aḍrum d usemmiḍ, ur tettwaseglya ara deg teqbaylit

notes.subject: asutureg i win yettɛemmiḍen
notes.rationale: Asutureg «anwa ad yezmer ad yeqqim?» ɣer win yettɛemmiḍen, ad t-id-yejbed ɣer uḍris

notes.subject: לפני קרתו
notes.rationale: 'ɣer zzat n usemmiḍ-is' (aḍris amezwaru) neɣ 'iḥequ usemmiḍ-is' (BSB)

translation: Ittazzal aḍrum-is am tiqectban meẓẓiyen; ɣer zzat n usemmiḍ-is, anwa ad yezmer ad yeqqim?
